# health-aggregator

> Aggregate dependency health checks concurrently with per-check timeouts, critical versus optional checks, a degraded state, caching and an HTTP handler Go module `github.com/Trysac/u043-health-aggregator`, package `healthaggregator`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
